```{r echo=FALSE}
# Initialization

## Package Import
invisible(lapply(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2",
                   "gstat", "tidyverse", "patchwork",
                   "broom", "lubridate", "fields",
                   "sp", "sf", "rnaturalearth",
                   "rnaturalearthdata"), 
  function(pkg) suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, 
                                                character.only = TRUE))))

## Data Import
data(wind)

## Data cleaning/prep
# Convert to tibble for easier handling
wind_tbl <- as_tibble(wind) %>%
  mutate(date = seq(as.Date("1961-01-01"), as.Date("1978-12-31"), by = "day")) %>%
  relocate(date)

# Long format
wind_long <- wind_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = RPT:MAL, names_to = "station", values_to = "wind")

# Collapse to monthly averages
wind_month <- wind_long %>%
  mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(station, ym) %>%
  summarise(wind = mean(wind, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(month = month(ym, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE))
```

# Gneiting-Matérn Space-time Covariance Model of Residuals via MLE

```{r}
# ======================================================================
# DETERMINISTIC — Build seasonal regressors & fit three models
# ======================================================================

wind_model <- wind_month %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = year(ym) + (month(ym) - 0.5)/12,
    t        = year_num - min(year_num),
    s1 = sin(2*pi*t),
    c1 = cos(2*pi*t)
  )

m_pooled     <- lm(wind ~ s1 + c1, data = wind_model)
m_intercepts <- lm(wind ~ station + s1 + c1, data = wind_model)
m_full       <- lm(wind ~ station * (s1 + c1), data = wind_model)

# --- Extract residuals from best deterministic model (Model C) ----------------
resid_C <- augment(m_full, data = wind_model) %>%
  transmute(station, ym, resid = .resid)

# ============================================================
# Fit Matérn space–time covariance to residuals
# ============================================================
wind.loc$y <- as.numeric(char2dms(as.character(wind.loc$Latitude)))
wind.loc$x <- as.numeric(char2dms(as.character(wind.loc$Longitude)))
coords <- wind.loc %>%
  mutate(
    y = as.numeric(char2dms(as.character(Latitude))),
    x = as.numeric(char2dms(as.character(Longitude)))
  ) %>%
  select(station = Code, x, y)

st_resid <- resid_C %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "station")

# ============================================================
# TRAIN–TEST SPLIT: remove last 6 months
# ============================================================

last6_months <- sort(unique(st_resid$ym), decreasing = TRUE)[1:6]
st_train <- st_resid %>% filter(!ym %in% last6_months)
st_test  <- st_resid %>% filter(ym %in% last6_months)

# ============================================================
# Fit Matérn space–time covariance to Irish monthly residuals
# ============================================================

# Use training residuals as df
df <- st_train %>% arrange(ym, station)

# Response
y <- df$resid
N <- length(y)

# Spatial distance matrix (lon/lat -> great-circle distance)
locs <- as.matrix(df[, c("x", "y")])
D_spatial <- rdist.earth(locs, miles = TRUE)

# Time in months since first month
time_vec <- as.numeric(difftime(df$ym, min(df$ym), units = "days")) / 30.4375
U_time <- abs(outer(time_vec, time_vec, "-"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# space–time Matérn covariance function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
matern_corr <- function(D, nu, range_s) {
  if (is.infinite(nu)) return(exp(-(D / range_s)^2))
  
  r <- sqrt(2 * nu) * D / range_s
  C <- (2^(1 - nu) / gamma(nu)) * (r^nu) * besselK(r, nu)
  C[r == 0] <- 1
  C
}

build_K_spacetime <- function(sigma2, beta_s, nu, nug, beta_t, gamma_st,
                              D_spatial, U_time) {
  alpha <- 1
  tau   <- 1   # d/2 for d = 2
  
  S         <- 1 + (U_time^(2 * alpha)) / beta_t      # ψ(|u|^2)
  range_mat <- beta_s * S^(gamma_st / 2)              # ℓ_ij = β_s ψ^{γ/2}
  R_mat     <- matern_corr(D_spatial, nu, range_mat)  # spatial Matérn
  K         <- sigma2 * S^(-tau) * R_mat              # σ² ψ^{-d/2} Matérn
  
  diag(K) <- diag(K) + nug
  K
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Negative log-likelihood and optimization
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nll <- function(par) {
  nug      <- 1e-6
  sigma2   <- par[1]^2
  beta_s   <- exp(par[2])
  beta_t   <- exp(par[3])
  gamma_st <- 1 / (1 + exp(-par[4]))  # logistic transform in (0,1)
  nu_val   <- exp(par[5])
  mu_val   <- 0                       # zero-mean residuals
  
  K <- build_K_spacetime(sigma2, beta_s, nu_val, nug, beta_t, gamma_st,
                         D_spatial, U_time)
  
  L <- tryCatch(chol(K), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(L)) return(1e10)
  
  z <- backsolve(L, y - mu_val, transpose = TRUE)
  logdetK <- 2 * sum(log(diag(L)))
  quad    <- sum(z^2)
  
  0.5 * N * log(2 * pi) + 0.5 * logdetK + 0.5 * quad
}

# Rough initial values 
init <- c(
  sqrt(var(y, na.rm = TRUE)),                            # sigma2 scale
  log(median(D_spatial[D_spatial > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),   # beta_s
  log(5),                                                # beta_t (months)
  0,                                                     # gamma_st on logit scale
  log(0.5)
)

fit <- optim(init, nll, control = list(trace = 3, maxit = 500))

est_par     <- fit$par
tausq_hat   <- 1e-6
sigma2_hat  <- est_par[1]^2
beta_s_hat  <- exp(est_par[2])
beta_t_hat  <- exp(est_par[3])
gamma_hat   <- 1 / (1 + exp(-est_par[4]))
nu_hat      <- exp(est_par[5])
mu_hat      <- 0

results <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("tau^2 (nugget)", "sigma^2 (variance)", "beta_s (spatial range, miles)",
                "beta_t (temporal range, months)", "gamma (space-time)", 
                "nu (smoothness)", "mu (mean)"),
  Estimated = c(tausq_hat, sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat, beta_t_hat,
                gamma_hat, nu_hat, mu_hat)
)

cat("Estimated Parameters (Irish monthly winds):\n")
print(results, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(results, file = "optimization_results.csv")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plot estimated space–time covariance
# --------------------------------------------------

# scalar C(h,u) consistent with build_K_spacetime
matern_spacetime_cov <- function(h, u, sigma2, beta_s, beta_t, gamma_st, nu, nug = 0) {
  alpha <- 1
  tau   <- 1
  
  S_u      <- 1 + (abs(u)^(2 * alpha)) / beta_t   # ψ(|u|^2)
  range_u  <- beta_s * S_u^(gamma_st / 2)         # ℓ(u) = β_s ψ^{γ/2}
  R        <- matern_corr(h, nu, range_u)         # Matérn(h; ℓ(u))
  cov_val  <- sigma2 * S_u^(-tau) * R             # σ² ψ^{-d/2} Matérn
  
  if (nug > 0 && u == 0) cov_val[h == 0] <- cov_val[h == 0] + nug
  cov_val
}

max_d <- max(D_spatial, na.rm = TRUE)
spatial_distance <- seq(0, max_d, length.out = 200)

time_points <- c(0, 1, 3, 6, 12)

colors <- c("#000000", "#004369", "#BE2D2D", "#0e6900", "#FF8C00")

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
par(ask = FALSE)

plot(NA,
     xlim = c(0, max(spatial_distance)),
     ylim = c(0, sigma2_hat + tausq_hat),
     xlab = "Spatial distance h (miles)",
     ylab = "C(h, u)",
     main = "Estimated Matérn space–time covariance (Irish monthly winds)",
     las = 1)


lines(spatial_distance, matern_spacetime_cov(spatial_distance, 0,
                                             sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat,
                                             beta_t_hat, gamma_hat,
                                             nu_hat, nug = tausq_hat))

for (j in seq_along(time_points)) {
  u <- time_points[j]
  cov_values <- matern_spacetime_cov(spatial_distance, u,
                                     sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat, beta_t_hat,
                                     gamma_hat, nu_hat, nug = tausq_hat)
  lines(spatial_distance, cov_values, col = colors[j], lwd = 2.5)
}

legend("topright",
       legend = paste("u =", time_points, "months"),
       col = colors[seq_along(time_points)],
       lwd = 2.5,
       bty = "n",
       title = "Time lag")
```


# Space-time Kriging

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SIMPLE KRIGING (mean = 0) IN SPACE–TIME
# ============================================================

df_test <- st_test %>% arrange(ym, station)

test_y <- df_test$resid
n_train <- N
n_test  <- length(test_y)

locs_train <- as.matrix(df[, c("x", "y")])
locs_test  <- as.matrix(df_test[, c("x", "y")])

time_vec_train <- time_vec
time_vec_test  <- as.numeric(difftime(df_test$ym, min(df$ym),
                                      units = "days")) / 30.4375

D_train       <- D_spatial
D_test_train  <- rdist.earth(locs_test, locs_train, miles = TRUE)

U_train      <- U_time
U_test_train <- abs(outer(time_vec_test, time_vec_train, "-"))

K <- build_K_spacetime(sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat, nu_hat,
                       tausq_hat, beta_t_hat, gamma_hat,
                       D_train, U_train)

K_inv <- solve(K)

k <- build_K_spacetime(sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat, nu_hat,
                       nug = 0,
                       beta_t_hat, gamma_hat,
                       D_test_train, U_test_train)

known_mean <- 0
train_Z    <- y
test_Z     <- test_y

pred_test <- k %*% (K_inv %*% (train_Z - known_mean)) + known_mean

c0 <- rep(sigma2_hat + tausq_hat, n_test)

tmp      <- k %*% K_inv
var_test <- c0 - rowSums(tmp * k)

mse_test <- mean((as.vector(pred_test) - test_Z)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nTest MSE on held-out months (residual process):", mse_test, "\n")

# ============================================================
# PREDICTIONS for next FIVE months with kriging variances
# ============================================================

n_future <- 5
future_months <- max(df$ym) %m+% months(1:n_future)

pred_list  <- vector("list", n_future)
var_list   <- vector("list", n_future)

# a loop to compute 5 months forward (in the original code from Dr. Salvaña,
# it only generate predictions for a single chosen month)
for (i in seq_len(n_future)) {
  target_month <- future_months[i]
  # time for each grid cell
  target_time <- as.numeric(difftime(target_month, min(df$ym),
                                     units="days")) / 30.4375
  time_vec_grid <- rep(target_time, nrow(grid_df))

  # space-time distances
  D_grid_train <- rdist.earth(grid_locs, locs_train, miles=TRUE)
  U_grid_train <- abs(outer(time_vec_grid, time_vec_train, "-"))

  # covariance between grid and training sites
  k_grid <- build_K_spacetime(
    sigma2_hat, beta_s_hat, nu_hat, nug=0,
    beta_t_hat, gamma_hat,
    D_grid_train, U_grid_train
  )

  # SK prediction: mean = 0
  pred_grid <- as.vector(k_grid %*% (K_inv %*% train_Z))

  # kriging variance at each grid point
  tmp <- k_grid %*% K_inv
  var_grid <- (sigma2_hat + tausq_hat) - rowSums(tmp * k_grid)

  pred_list[[i]] <- pred_grid
  var_list[[i]]  <- var_grid
}

names(pred_list) <- format(future_months, "%Y-%m")
names(var_list)  <- format(future_months, "%Y-%m")
```
